meta.description:
Want to buy a pair of these puppies? https://sovrn.co/1259roi
Or the high tops? https://sovrn.co/4vz70ct

The Converse Chuck Taylor 70’s! A little upgrade to their old digs you see! The classic Chuck Taylors are legendary but there were a lot of cost saving measures taken in the 80’s and 90’s when Converse wasn’t as popular as when they pretty much owned the market. But fear not! 10 years after they were bought by Nike they faithfully reproduced chucks how they were made in the 70’s and WOWIE KAPOWIIE are they better! Also these are not high tops and I have a troubled past with high tops but...maybe one day I’ll get a pair. I just need to overcome the pain and agony of trying to put them on first.
